name: Burkardt mm_io
reason: The official dated C source provides mm_read_mtx_crd and appears in the NIST mmio API/reader lineage. Its page says the information on the web page is MIT-licensed, but does not explicitly license the linked C source, which has no license header. No comparable Homebrew adoption metric was found. Keep this as a lead until the source-license scope and distinct package/adoption case are established; a working parser API alone is insufficient for inclusion.
